description: This file defines classes for sanitizing HTML content, including handling XHTML, MathML, SVG, and inline styles. It includes methods for filtering and cleaning HTML tokens, attributes, and CSS styles to ensure safe and compliant output.

classes.name: HTMLSanitizerMixin
classes.description: Provides methods and constants for sanitizing HTML tokens, attributes, and CSS styles, including allowed elements, attributes, CSS properties, and protocols.

classes.name: HTMLSanitizer
classes.description: Extends HTMLTokenizer with sanitization capabilities, iterates over tokens, and applies filtering to produce sanitized HTML output.

methods.name: sanitize_token
methods.description: Sanitizes individual HTML tokens based on their type and name, filtering allowed elements and attributes.

methods.name: allowed_token
methods.description: Processes tokens that are allowed, sanitizing attributes and CSS styles.

methods.name: disallowed_token
methods.description: Processes tokens that are not allowed, converting them into safe representations.

methods.name: sanitize_css
methods.description: Cleans CSS style strings, allowing only permitted properties, keywords, and safe URL formats.
